note: Zero-shot character probes for the LAION-CLAP music audio tower. Each axis scores a sound as the mean cosine similarity of its audio embedding to the positive phrasings minus the mean to the negative ones (the 'contrast' used in daw's audio-model baseline). 'center' and 'scale' map the contrast to a 0..1 probability-like value: 1 / (1 + exp(-(contrast - center) / scale)).
